title: Hi Corey Here - Doom Tss Deseos (Vocal Layer Main)
style: ultra high-energy progressive house festival mainstage banger, fast 130 BPM club-destroyer energy with massive euphoric drops and huge builds. Main foundation is dense wordless vocal production only: one voice mimics all instruments (shimmering supersaw leads, rolling deep sub basslines, arpeggios, stabs, crisp claps, snares and pads created with mouth/throat/breath). Second voice delivers deep resonant Australian didgeridoo drones with circular breathing, growls, overtones and long pulsing vibrations. Heavy pure vocal percussion drives everything using the exact repeated doom-tss-doom-doom-tss pattern as core rhythm. Two real singers (warm confident male baritone + bright energetic soulful female) layered lightly on top with MINIMAL singing — very short powerful phrases, lush harmonies and ad-libs only so the rich wordless vocal layer, didgeridoo and doom-tss percussion remain the main star. Energetic fun party vibe, zero sap, wide stereo imaging, professional studio mix clarity.
